name: Adaptive reverb
summary: The 3D + LTX template: one LTX-2.5 (open weights) + AKUSPACE LoRA take through a cathedral, a crowded hall and a small wooden studio, its own sound changing with each room and kept as the track, under a room-scan surveillance look, with the workflow's node diagram and an editable end card. Nothing is generated.

versions.title: The first cut, the whole take
versions.summary: The fourth mix template: the whole take on one track slot over its own sound, a wireframe sweep and slice glitch at each room change, a room scan in the cathedral (scanlines, REC / CAM HUD, measure box, RT60 readouts), the workflow as a node diagram before the studio, and the construction end card over a frame of the studio.
changes: The take encoded once at its native 1280 × 720, CRF 18, no sound
Its own sound as the track, AAC to MP3 320 kb/s, otherwise untouched; 60.5 beats at 120 BPM, 726 frames
No new recipe: screen-open, build-panel, wire-scan, slice-glitch, crt, hud, ui-focus, scan, space-hud and end-card-still
Gallery: Adaptive reverb (3D · LTX template) takes the Audio-visual card's place

events.reason: Owner, 30 Oct 2026: an "Adaptive reverb" template, "proof that this is made with LTX-2.5 (open weights) + our AKUSPACE acoustic-space LoRA, open source". The source video has its own audio, and the reverb changes per room: a drop between skyscrapers into a cathedral, then a crowded hall, then a small wooden studio with drums and keys. "Keep the video's own audio as the track (do not replace it); use its full length."
